definitions.explanation: The action of two or more things happening in turn, one after another in a repeating pattern. Most commonly used adverbially with に as {交互|こうご}に.

examples.japanese: {交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I arranged the red and white ones alternately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The two of them advanced the interview, taking turns answering questions.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as {交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (alternately, in turn). Can modify verbs to describe any action done in alternation between two or more parties or elements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look back and forth)
- {交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to alternate repeatedly)
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{交互|こうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (alternating left and right)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: taking turns — focuses on replacing one person/thing with another
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in order, in sequence — more general sequential ordering
